title: RETO: «hay mucha gente»

options: There are a lot of people

correction.right: There are a lot of people

voice: Casi todos dudan aquí. ¿Cómo dirías «hay mucha gente»?
¿[[There is many people]], [[There are a lot of people]] o [[Has a lot of people]]?
¡La B! [[There are a lot of people]]. [[People]] es plural, así que va [[there are]].
Y nunca [[has]] para «hay»: «hay» es [[there is]] o [[there are]].
Para algo incontable: [[There's a lot of traffic]].
¿Acertaste? Pon un sí o un no en comentarios.

challenge.answer: There were a lot of people at the party.

caption: «Hay mucha gente» es «There are a lot of people». There is vs there are en un reto.
